description: NHFLOW semi-implicit step with the non-hydrostatic pressure under a steep progressive wave: 5th-order Stokes wave kh 3, ka 0.21 (d 1 m, H 0.14 m, T 1.14 s) in a tank of 8 wavelengths (512 x 4 cells, sigma stretching B 103 5, dt T/58, A 510 11, A 508 1), 26 periods. The phi face terms of the cells are inside the column solve, so the implicit half of the vertical advection acts on the velocity of t^{n+1}; added after the solve, the layers exchanged horizontal momentum in the mean and a shear current grew by 3.6 mm/s per second (0.2 with the terms in the solve).
covers: nhflow_momentum_SI::cell_update with nh_cell_faces (the phi face terms in the column solve)
nhflow_momentum_SI::col_coef (central vertical advection) under a steep wave
Stokes-5 relaxation zone (B 92 5) with the semi-implicit step
